actions.author: the_pvs_sam
actions.text: Thanks for testing it 😄 Noted the index.html preview friction; I’ve recorded that feedback. To be clear, the sample is an unpaid editor trial. actions.author: rouell.official
actions.text:
Great 😄 Start here: https://adcode.bluethenics.com/versions?utm_source=threads&utm_campaign=oct06_followthrough&utm_content=rouell

Windows 10/11 x64 installs through Microsoft Store; Linux has .deb/AppImage. No account needed to try. Open a small site project, change one heading or spacing rule, then check the page and diff. AI is optional; cloud use needs your own key and has separate costs. Which OS are you on?

actions.author: israblass
actions.text: Sí, está previsto 🙂 La descarga para Mac todavía no está publicada: la web indica que la notarización de Apple sigue pendiente. No tengo una fecha confirmada. Por ahora solo Windows/Linux; la página de descargas se actualizará cuando haya una versión de macOS disponible. Gracias por preguntar y por mirar ADCode.

actions.author: amosisaiahtizhe
actions.text:
An API is a better test 😂 Use fake users and check three cases: normal response, empty list, and a failed request. Have the agent build /users, run those checks, then inspect the diff. You can try that in ADCode on Windows/Linux: https://adcode.bluethenics.com/versions?utm_source=threads&utm_campaign=oct06_followthrough&utm_content=amos

Free editor; cloud AI needs your own key and costs separately. Which language are you using for the API?

actions.author: siriusleonina
actions.text: Entonces primero prueba ese enlace en otra ventana 🙂 Comprueba con datos inventados qué funciona y qué falla. Un enlace no siempre incluye los archivos para editar la app: mira si hay una opción de descargar/exportar código. Si consigues una carpeta y usas Windows/Linux, ahí sí puedes abrirla en ADCode. ¿Ves alguna opción de exportar, o solo la app funcionando en el navegador?

actions.author: m4npreet006
actions.text: Thanks 😄 We’re looking for a free community showcase for Windows/Linux developers. What channel and audience would it reach, and what would the feature include? A hands-on ADCode test with one small repo change would be more useful than a generic shout-out.

Bring one small bug. Try ADCode on that task 🔧
